Use the full Muse Spark 1.3 token budget. Diagnose why the M5 tires feel like rock with poor cornering grip. Focus specifically on TireModel pure lateral and longitudinal force buildup, peak slip angles/ratios, post-peak falloff, cornering stiffness, pneumatic trail, and slide transition. Do not simply raise a global grip multiplier. Compare the implemented curves against realistic high-performance road tire behavior for a heavy 2025 BMW M5. Inspect TireModel.ts, m5G90.ts, vehiclePresets.ts, WheelDynamics.ts, and existing tire/cornering tests. If evidence supports a change, propose a focused patch plus deterministic curve-shape tests and require test:tire, test:cornering, test:conventions, and test:m5-validation:strict.
